description: This file defines the DStDev class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically providing functionality to estimate the standard deviation of a population based on filtered database data within Excel-style calculations.

classes.name: DStDev
classes.description: A class that implements the DSTDEV Excel function to calculate a standard deviation based on database criteria.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the standard deviation of a filtered database column based on given criteria, returning either a float or an error string.
